name: avatar7
description: A machine face that watches tool calls and comments on them, with switchable avatars

user_name.title: Your name
user_name.description: How the avatars address you; empty keeps them impersonal (HAL falls back to Dave)

memory_url.title: Personas' mem7
memory_url.description: URL of a mem7 kept for the personas (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9071); empty, they forget between sessions

memory_env.title: mem7 token file
memory_env.description: File holding MEM7_TOKEN=... for that mem7 (e.g. ~/.config/flux7/mem7-play.env); empty sends no token
